mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT sd1.secid FROM interf_payhsrcsecschedule sd1 WHERE sd1.update_time >= ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE ( DATE_FORMAT ( max( sd.update_time ), '%Y-%m-%d' ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) FROM interf_payhsrcsecschedule sd ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT fp.finprod_id FROM fin_product fp LEFT JOIN fin_product_add ad ON fp.finprod_id = ad.finprod_id WHERE fp.finprod_type = 'F01' AND fp.finprod_market_id = sd1.secid AND ad.is_auto_update = 'Y' ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT sd1.secid FROM interf_payhsrcsecoption sd1 WHERE sd1.update_time >= ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE ( DATE_FORMAT ( max( sd.update_time ), '%Y-%m-%d' ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) FROM interf_payhsrcsecoption sd ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT fp.finprod_id FROM fin_product fp LEFT JOIN fin_product_add ad ON fp.finprod_id = ad.finprod_id WHERE fp.finprod_type = 'F01' AND fp.finprod_market_id = sd1.secid AND ad.is_auto_update = 'Y' )
